policy: Lexical approvals must cite a pinned primary lexical dataset snapshot. A decision is not valid merely because a reviewer marked it approved. Prefer TBESG for concise NT lexical review; use TFLSJ only when TBESG has no adequate entry or when fuller LSJ evidence is required.
